mainEntity.name: Can you fix a leaking shower without removing the tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, yes. The majority of shower leaks come from failed silicone, cracked grout or a worn waterproofing membrane at the junctions, and all of those can be repaired from the surface with no demolition or re-tiling.

Usually it comes down to worn sealants or faulty tiles. Silicone perishes, grout cracks as the building moves, and the membrane underneath eventually gives up. A inspection will tell you which one it is.

mainEntity.name: How long does a leaking shower repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical repair takes a few hours, depending on the issue. Most resealing and regrouting jobs are finished in a single visit and the shower is usually ready to use again within 24 hours.

mainEntity.name: How much does a leaking shower repair cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary with the cause and the size of the shower, and repairing early usually saves money. We give you a fixed scope quote after an inspection, so you see an itemised price before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: Will I need to replace my tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not always. Tiles are only replaced if they are damaged or if they are the source of the leak itself.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide a waterproofing certificate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every completed waterproofing job comes with a certificate, along with our 100% workmanship guarantee.

mainEntity.name: Is mould a sign of a leaking shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can be. Constant dampness behind tiles and in the surrounding rooms creates the conditions mould needs, so recurring mould is worth having inspected.

mainEntity.name: How often should shower sealants be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every one to two years as a general rule, or sooner if you start seeing leaks, lifting silicone or dark staining along the joints.

mainEntity.name: Do you service all of Sydney?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We cover all 33 Sydney local government areas and we come to you. Tell us your suburb and we will confirm the next available inspection.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with strata and commercial properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We regularly handle residential, commercial and strata or body corporate bathroom and balcony leaks right across Sydney.

Privacy Policy

This policy explains what personal information Fix Leaking Showers collects, how we use it, and the choices you have. We handle your information in line with the Australian Privacy Principles.

What we collect

When you enquire through our website, call us, or book an inspection, we collect the details you give us, typically your name, phone number, email, suburb and a description of the issue. We do not collect more than we need to quote and carry out the work.

How we use it

We use your information to respond to your enquiry, arrange and carry out your inspection and any work, and keep records of the job and its guarantee. We may contact you about your enquiry or job.

Analytics and cookies

Our website may use standard analytics (such as Google Analytics) to understand how the site is used. This data is aggregated and is not used to identify you personally. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

Who we share it with

We do not sell your personal information. We only share it where needed to deliver your job (for example, a team member attending your property) or where required by law.

Your choices

You can ask us what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it, by calling 1300 525 699. We will action reasonable requests promptly.

Contact
